Module net.automatalib.api
Package net.automatalib.automaton.mmlt

Interface SymbolCombiner<S>

Type Parameters:
S - symbol type
All Known Implementing Classes:
StringSymbolCombiner
public interface SymbolCombiner<S>
A symbol combiner deterministically maps between multiple output symbols and a single representative. This functionality is currently used by MMLTs when multiple timeouts occur simultaneously.
